title: Prescription Settings of the Tailwise Autoship Programs
content:
Tailwise Pharmacy fills the two prescription programs of Tailwise Autoship. This settings sheet states, for every program, whether a prescription is required, the largest days' supply one shipment may hold, and how long a prescription hold may last before the subscription is cancelled automatically.

| Program | Every shipment requires a linked active prescription with a fill remaining | Largest days' supply in one shipment | Calendar days on prescription hold before automatic cancellation |
|---|---|---|---|
| Autoship Everyday | No | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) |
| Autoship Litter & Bulk | No | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) |
| Autoship Fresh & Frozen | No | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) |
| Autoship Custom Meal Plan | No | 0 (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) |
| Autoship Pharmacy | Yes | 90 | 30 |
| Autoship Compounded Pharmacy | Yes | 30 | 30 |

A figure of 0 in either day column means the setting does not apply to the program.

### Illustration (hypothetical package of 30 days' supply)

- On Autoship Pharmacy, a shipment of 3 such packages holds 90 days' supply, which is the largest allowed; 4 packages (120 days) would exceed it.
- On Autoship Compounded Pharmacy, 1 such package (30 days) is the largest shipment allowed.
